description.value: The Best Grill is a casual American-style diner in Langley Township serving all-day breakfast alongside a broad menu of homemade burgers, eggs benedicts, and sandwiches. The extensive made-from-scratch menu — including multiple burger builds and a full eggs benedict lineup — makes it a solid refuelling stop for cyclists riding the Fraser Valley. Online ordering and delivery are available through the Focal Eats platform.
